demos.answer: Under Article 14, high-risk AI systems must be designed and developed with appropriate human-machine interface tools to enable effective oversight by natural persons during system use (Article 14(1)). This oversight aims to prevent or minimize risks to health, safety, or fundamental rights that may arise during system operation (Article 14(2)). Complementing this, ISO 42001 requires meaningful human oversight, including: human review mechanisms for high-risk decisions, override capabilities for operators, system outputs presented to support informed human judgment, and escalation procedures for edge cases. Providers must ensure these oversight mechanisms are implemented as part of their obligations under Article 16(a), which requires compliance with Section 2 requirements (including Article 14).
